top_news.title: Gold prices struggle to hold early gains as U.S. dollar nears 18-month high, bond yields remain elevated - Kitco AM Report
top_news.summary: (Kitco NewsWire) – The gold market is struggling to maintain its recent recovery as persistent inflation pressures, elevated bond yields and a U.S. dollar trading near an 18-month high continue to create significant headwinds for the precious metal ahead of another critical week of economic data.Gold prices started the week with modest gains, briefly trading above $4,200 an ounce during the Asian session; however, bullish momentum has faded as investors remain reluctant to take significant positions ahead of Wednesday's U.S. Consumer Price Index report.Spot gold was last quoted around $4,156.20 an ounce ahead of the North American trading session, down nearly 1% on the day. The precious metal has been unable to build on last week's recovery after prices briefly fell below $4,100 an ounce. Despite the recent buying momentum, gold remains well below its August highs as investors continue to assess the implications of tighter monetary policy and stubborn inflation.Silver is also struggling to maintain its recovery, with prices trading around $60.35 an ounce after briefly pushing above $61 earlier in the session.The latest U.S. economic data continues to paint a complicated picture for financial markets as weakening consumer confidence contrasts with persistently elevated inflation expectations.On Friday, the University of Michigan reported that its preliminary consumer sentiment index fell to 46.3 in October, down from 48.1 in September and below expectations of 47.6. The current economic conditions index dropped sharply to 44.7, its lowest reading on record.At the same time, consumers' one-year inflation expectations increased to 4.7%, up from 4.6%, while longer-term expectations rose to 3.5% from 3.4%.The disappointing sentiment data follows September's weaker-than-expected employment report, which showed that the U.S. economy created only 29,000 jobs, while the unemployment rate increased to 4.2%. Although signs of slowing economic growth would normally support expectations for looser monetary policy, persistent inflation pressures continue to complicate the Federal Reserve's outlook.Market positioning remains tilted toward further monetary tightening, with interest rate futures reflecting roughly an 85% probability of at least one additional rate hike by December. Investors see only about a 17% chance of a rate increase at the October meeting. The divergence between slowing employment growth and elevated inflation expectations is keeping Treasury yields and the U.S. dollar supported, limiting gold's ability to sustain its recent recovery.The U.S. dollar remains a significant obstacle for the precious metal, with the U.S. Dollar Index holding near 102.20, close to its highest level in approximately 18 months. (Kitco Global Index shows how much of today's gold move is the dollar versus the gold market itself.)Simon-Peter Massabni, Head of Business Development at XS.com, said that the dollar continues to benefit from the combination of persistent energy inflation, geopolitical uncertainty and elevated U.S. Treasury yields.Massabni added that persistent inflation pressures are preventing central banks from easing monetary policy and forcing fixed-income markets to adjust to expectations for higher interest rates.Although the dollar's strength is weighing on gold, analysts note that the precious metal continues to attract safe-haven interest as investors navigate deteriorating economic conditions and growing geopolitical uncertainty.The ongoing conflict between the United States and Iran remains a significant source of uncertainty, particularly as negotiations to reopen the Strait of Hormuz have failed to produce a lasting resolution. Iranian officials have rejected U.S. proposals as inadequate, while renewed attacks on Saudi Arabian infrastructure and continued military deployments have raised concerns about further regional escalation. Although oil prices have eased following President Donald Trump's announcement of a proposed energy ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine, the risk of renewed disruptions to Middle Eastern energy supplies remains elevated. Brent crude has retreated toward $105 a barrel, while West Texas Intermediate is trading above $92 a barrel. For gold, the conflict remains a double-edged sword: geopolitical uncertainty supports safe-haven demand, but higher energy prices threaten to keep inflation elevated, reinforcing expectations for tighter monetary policy.Meanwhile, the U.S. bond market continues to present another significant challenge for gold as the benchmark 10-year Treasury yield remains well above 5%, near levels not seen in almost two decades. Although rising yields increase the opportunity cost of holding non-yielding assets such as gold, analysts note that the reasons behind the bond market's weakness are becoming increasingly important. With U.S. sovereign debt exceeding $40 trillion and annual interest costs surpassing $1 trillion, investors are demanding greater compensation for the risks associated with holding long-term government debt. Persistent inflation, growing borrowing requirements and concerns about the sustainability of U.S. fiscal policy are contributing to higher term premiums. While these developments create immediate headwinds for gold, they could also reinforce its longer-term appeal as an alternative monetary asset and portfolio diversification tool.Massabni said that despite the current headwinds, gold is approaching an important technical and fundamental turning point."The key question is not simply whether gold can rebound from this area, but whether the underlying economic and fundamental conditions are strong enough to turn a potential recovery into a more sustainable bullish trend," he said.He identified the area between $4,155 and $4,177 an ounce as an important support zone, adding that a sustained recovery will depend on whether inflation data allows Treasury yields and the U.S. dollar to lose momentum.However, he warned that stronger-than-expected inflation could reinforce expectations for additional monetary tightening, potentially exposing gold to renewed selling pressure.The market's next major test will come Wednesday with the release of September's Consumer Price Index. Investors will be watching whether rising energy prices are becoming embedded in broader inflation pressures, particularly core consumer prices.A softer-than-expected inflation report could ease expectations for further Federal Reserve rate hikes, providing some relief for gold and silver. Conversely, another upside inflation surprise could push bond yields and the dollar higher, increasing the risk of renewed selling pressure across the precious metals complex.Gold's near-term outlook remains bearish as prices continue to trade below a descending trendline and longer-term moving averages. Initial support is seen at $4,175.03 an ounce, followed by $4,141.86 and $4,103.24. A break below these levels could expose further downside toward $4,067.42. On the upside, initial resistance is seen at $4,226.82, with a sustained break above that level potentially opening the door to $4,271.57 and $4,311.17. Analysts note that gold will need to overcome its declining trendline to establish a more sustainable bullish recovery.Meanwhile, silver's technical outlook also remains cautious as the precious metal struggles to overcome resistance from its declining trendline. Analysts are watching initial support at $59.96 an ounce, followed by $58.74 and $57.64. On the upside, initial resistance is seen at $61.72, followed by $63.06 and $65.09. A sustained move above $61.72 would be an important indication of improving bullish momentum, while a break below $59.96 could signal renewed selling pressure.Although precious metals remain vulnerable to further near-term volatility, underlying investment demand continues to provide some support. Global gold-backed exchange-traded funds attracted approximately $10 billion in September, with holdings rising to a record 4,256 tonnes. Central bank demand also remains elevated, with official-sector purchases projected at approximately 720 tonnes this year.With U.S. Treasury markets closed Monday for the Columbus Day holiday, trading conditions could remain relatively subdued as investors wait for fresh inflation data and further clarity on the Federal Reserve's monetary policy outlook.See live precious metals prices for gold, silver, platinum and palladium — in USD, CAD and 12 more currencies.

top_news.title: T-MAXIMUM
top_news.summary: BEIJING, Oct. 12, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- T-MAXIMUM PHARMACEUTICAL ("T-MAXIMUM") today announced that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has cleared the company to initiate a Phase 2 clinical study of MT027, its internally developed, B7-H3-targeted universal (allogeneic) CAR-T therapy, for the treatment of patients with brain metastases from lung cancer and breast cancer. This is the second Phase 2 study of MT027 to receive FDA clearance. MT027 was previously cleared by the FDA to proceed with a Phase 2 study in recurrent glioblastoma, and has been granted Orphan Drug Designation (ODD) and Fast Track Designation (FTD). With two FDA-cleared Phase 2 programs, T-MAXIMUM has established a dual-indication portfolio for universal CAR-T therapy covering both primary and metastatic intracranial solid tumors. Image source: T-MAXIMUM official website (www.t-maximum.com) Brain Metastases: An Unanswered Clinical Question Despite Advances in Systemic Therapy Brain metastases commonly arise in patients with lung cancer, breast cancer, melanoma, renal cell carcinoma, and colorectal cancer. International studies estimate that approximately 20% of cancer patients may develop brain metastases over the course of their disease, a proportion that can reach 20% to 40% among patients with advanced solid tumors.[1][2] For patients, this means far more than an additional lesion on imaging: brain metastases may be accompanied by headaches, seizures, and cognitive and motor impairment, directly affecting daily life and subsequent treatment options. This is a truly global clinical challenge. In 2022, there were nearly 20 million new cancer cases worldwide, including nearly 2.5 million new cases of lung cancer and approximately 2.3 million new cases of female breast cancer - the two leading primary tumor types giving rise to brain metastases.[3] Asia accounts for roughly half of all new cancer cases globally;[4] in the United States, an estimated 200,000 to 300,000 patients are newly diagnosed with brain metastases each year.[2] This large patient population means brain metastasis is not a niche need, but a question that oncology worldwide must continue to answer. Systemic therapies can help control disease throughout the body, but treatment of intracranial lesions often remains constrained by multiple factors, including the blood-brain barrier, tumor heterogeneity, and the need to preserve neurological function. This is especially true for patients who experience intracranial progression after prior therapy, for whom there remains a need for more treatment options that are validated intracranially while balancing safety and accessibility. Consecutive Clinical Milestones Built on Long-Term Product and Translational Groundwork MT027's recent series of regulatory milestones is no coincidence. It reflects an integrated capability across product, manufacturing, clinical development, and regulatory affairs built around intracranial solid tumors - one that is now advancing from early exploration toward more systematic clinical validation. First, a foundation of clinical data. The company has accumulated sustained clinical experience in local delivery, repeat dosing, and safety monitoring for intracranial solid tumors. Years of clinical experience and data with MT027 have already led to two FDA-cleared Phase 2 programs. Data from an investigator-initiated trial (IIT) of MT026, a program built on the same platform, were published in Nature Communications in 2026: among 5 patients with recurrent high-grade glioma, 1 complete response and 3 partial responses were observed, for an objective response rate (ORR) of 80%, with no treatment-related Grade 3 or higher adverse events. Early clinical data for MT027 in patients with refractory brain metastases from lung cancer were previously presented at the IASLC 2026 World Conference on Lung Cancer (WCLC 2026). Five heavily pretreated patients with no guideline-recommended subsequent treatment options completed treatment; among the 3 evaluable patients, 2 partial responses were observed. The safety profile was favorable, with no Grade 3 or higher adverse events and no graft-versus-host disease (GvHD). These rigorous exploratory clinical studies provide an important basis for the clinical translation of allogeneic, locally delivered CAR-T therapy in intracranial solid tumors. Second, a well-defined manufacturing process. MT027 is manufactured using a fully non-viral gene-editing process - a generational departure from the industry's mainstream lentiviral vector approach - offering potential advantages in product safety, batch-to-batch consistency, and cost control. The manufacturing process was established and locked prior to entering Phase 2 clinical development. Third, leadership measured not only by getting there first, but by advancing systematically. For an innovative cell therapy company, leadership in regulatory progress comes from coordinated advancement across product, manufacturing, clinical development, and regulatory strategy. MT027's consecutive entry into FDA-cleared Phase 2 clinical development demonstrates T-MAXIMUM's ability to translate its prior groundwork into a repeatable and scalable clinical development capability. Management Commentary "Receiving FDA clearance for two consecutive Phase 2 studies of MT027 marks a pivotal step built on our sustained work in intracranial solid tumors. From glioma to brain metastases, we have always let the data speak and put clinical value first. Going forward, we will continue to rigorously evaluate the product's safety and potential clinical value through well-designed clinical studies, steadily advancing product supply, clinical execution, and the generation of key data, as we explore new possibilities for patients who lack effective treatment options." About MT027 MT027 is an investigational, B7-H3-targeted universal (allogeneic) CAR-T cell therapy developed by T-MAXIMUM using a fully non-viral gene-editing process and administered via local intracranial delivery. MT027 has received FDA Orphan Drug Designation and Fast Track Designation and is being evaluated in FDA-cleared Phase 2 studies in recurrent glioblastoma and in brain metastases from lung cancer and breast cancer. About T-MAXIMUM PHARMACEUTICAL T-MAXIMUM PHARMACEUTICAL is a clinical-stage cell therapy company focused on developing universal (allogeneic) CAR-T therapies for intracranial solid tumors with high unmet medical need, including recurrent glioblastoma and brain metastases. Through engineered cell therapies, local delivery strategies, and clinical translation capabilities, the Company is advancing more accessible treatment approaches with the potential to support repeat dosing. Its lead program, MT027, is a B7-H3-targeted universal CAR-T therapy that has received FDA clearance to initiate Phase 2 clinical studies in recurrent glioblastoma and brain metastases. MT027 has also received Orphan Drug Designation (ODD) in high-grade glioma and Fast Track Designation (FTD) for recurrent or progressive glioblastoma. T-MAXIMUM is working to translate its accumulated capabilities in product development, manufacturing, and clinical execution into continued innovation across both primary and metastatic intracranial solid tumors, with the goal of creating new possibilities for patients with limited treatment options. Forward-Looking Statements This press release contains forward-looking statements, including statements regarding the clinical development, potential therapeutic benefits, manufacturing advantages, and regulatory progress of MT027 and other product candidates. These statements are based on current expectations and are subject to risks and uncertainties, including those inherent in clinical development, regulatory review, and manufacturing, that could cause actual results to differ materially. Early clinical results from small numbers of patients may not be predictive of results in larger studies. MT027 is an investigational product, and its safety and efficacy have not been established. articles.title: Gold prices struggle to hold early gains as U.S. dollar nears 18-month high, bond yields remain elevated - Kitco AM Report
articles.summary: (Kitco NewsWire) – The gold market is struggling to maintain its recent recovery as persistent inflation pressures, elevated bond yields and a U.S. dollar trading near an 18-month high continue to create significant headwinds for the precious metal ahead of another critical week of economic data.Gold prices started the week with modest gains, briefly trading above $4,200 an ounce during the Asian session; however, bullish momentum has faded as investors remain reluctant to take significant positions ahead of Wednesday's U.S. Consumer Price Index report.Spot gold was last quoted around $4,156.20 an ounce ahead of the North American trading session, down nearly 1% on the day. The precious metal has been unable to build on last week's recovery after prices briefly fell below $4,100 an ounce. Despite the recent buying momentum, gold remains well below its August highs as investors continue to assess the implications of tighter monetary policy and stubborn inflation.Silver is also struggling to maintain its recovery, with prices trading around $60.35 an ounce after briefly pushing above $61 earlier in the session.The latest U.S. economic data continues to paint a complicated picture for financial markets as weakening consumer confidence contrasts with persistently elevated inflation expectations.On Friday, the University of Michigan reported that its preliminary consumer sentiment index fell to 46.3 in October, down from 48.1 in September and below expectations of 47.6. The current economic conditions index dropped sharply to 44.7, its lowest reading on record.At the same time, consumers' one-year inflation expectations increased to 4.7%, up from 4.6%, while longer-term expectations rose to 3.5% from 3.4%.The disappointing sentiment data follows September's weaker-than-expected employment report, which showed that the U.S. economy created only 29,000 jobs, while the unemployment rate increased to 4.2%. Although signs of slowing economic growth would normally support expectations for looser monetary policy, persistent inflation pressures continue to complicate the Federal Reserve's outlook.Market positioning remains tilted toward further monetary tightening, with interest rate futures reflecting roughly an 85% probability of at least one additional rate hike by December. Investors see only about a 17% chance of a rate increase at the October meeting. The divergence between slowing employment growth and elevated inflation expectations is keeping Treasury yields and the U.S. dollar supported, limiting gold's ability to sustain its recent recovery.The U.S. dollar remains a significant obstacle for the precious metal, with the U.S. Dollar Index holding near 102.20, close to its highest level in approximately 18 months. (Kitco Global Index shows how much of today's gold move is the dollar versus the gold market itself.)Simon-Peter Massabni, Head of Business Development at XS.com, said that the dollar continues to benefit from the combination of persistent energy inflation, geopolitical uncertainty and elevated U.S. Treasury yields.Massabni added that persistent inflation pressures are preventing central banks from easing monetary policy and forcing fixed-income markets to adjust to expectations for higher interest rates.Although the dollar's strength is weighing on gold, analysts note that the precious metal continues to attract safe-haven interest as investors navigate deteriorating economic conditions and growing geopolitical uncertainty.The ongoing conflict between the United States and Iran remains a significant source of uncertainty, particularly as negotiations to reopen the Strait of Hormuz have failed to produce a lasting resolution. Iranian officials have rejected U.S. proposals as inadequate, while renewed attacks on Saudi Arabian infrastructure and continued military deployments have raised concerns about further regional escalation. Although oil prices have eased following President Donald Trump's announcement of a proposed energy ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine, the risk of renewed disruptions to Middle Eastern energy supplies remains elevated. Brent crude has retreated toward $105 a barrel, while West Texas Intermediate is trading above $92 a barrel. For gold, the conflict remains a double-edged sword: geopolitical uncertainty supports safe-haven demand, but higher energy prices threaten to keep inflation elevated, reinforcing expectations for tighter monetary policy.Meanwhile, the U.S. bond market continues to present another significant challenge for gold as the benchmark 10-year Treasury yield remains well above 5%, near levels not seen in almost two decades. Although rising yields increase the opportunity cost of holding non-yielding assets such as gold, analysts note that the reasons behind the bond market's weakness are becoming increasingly important. With U.S. sovereign debt exceeding $40 trillion and annual interest costs surpassing $1 trillion, investors are demanding greater compensation for the risks associated with holding long-term government debt. Persistent inflation, growing borrowing requirements and concerns about the sustainability of U.S. fiscal policy are contributing to higher term premiums. While these developments create immediate headwinds for gold, they could also reinforce its longer-term appeal as an alternative monetary asset and portfolio diversification tool.Massabni said that despite the current headwinds, gold is approaching an important technical and fundamental turning point."The key question is not simply whether gold can rebound from this area, but whether the underlying economic and fundamental conditions are strong enough to turn a potential recovery into a more sustainable bullish trend," he said.He identified the area between $4,155 and $4,177 an ounce as an important support zone, adding that a sustained recovery will depend on whether inflation data allows Treasury yields and the U.S. dollar to lose momentum.However, he warned that stronger-than-expected inflation could reinforce expectations for additional monetary tightening, potentially exposing gold to renewed selling pressure.The market's next major test will come Wednesday with the release of September's Consumer Price Index. Investors will be watching whether rising energy prices are becoming embedded in broader inflation pressures, particularly core consumer prices.A softer-than-expected inflation report could ease expectations for further Federal Reserve rate hikes, providing some relief for gold and silver. Conversely, another upside inflation surprise could push bond yields and the dollar higher, increasing the risk of renewed selling pressure across the precious metals complex.Gold's near-term outlook remains bearish as prices continue to trade below a descending trendline and longer-term moving averages. Initial support is seen at $4,175.03 an ounce, followed by $4,141.86 and $4,103.24. A break below these levels could expose further downside toward $4,067.42. On the upside, initial resistance is seen at $4,226.82, with a sustained break above that level potentially opening the door to $4,271.57 and $4,311.17. Analysts note that gold will need to overcome its declining trendline to establish a more sustainable bullish recovery.Meanwhile, silver's technical outlook also remains cautious as the precious metal struggles to overcome resistance from its declining trendline. Analysts are watching initial support at $59.96 an ounce, followed by $58.74 and $57.64. On the upside, initial resistance is seen at $61.72, followed by $63.06 and $65.09. A sustained move above $61.72 would be an important indication of improving bullish momentum, while a break below $59.96 could signal renewed selling pressure.Although precious metals remain vulnerable to further near-term volatility, underlying investment demand continues to provide some support. Global gold-backed exchange-traded funds attracted approximately $10 billion in September, with holdings rising to a record 4,256 tonnes. Central bank demand also remains elevated, with official-sector purchases projected at approximately 720 tonnes this year.With U.S. Treasury markets closed Monday for the Columbus Day holiday, trading conditions could remain relatively subdued as investors wait for fresh inflation data and further clarity on the Federal Reserve's monetary policy outlook.See live precious metals prices for gold, silver, platinum and palladium — in USD, CAD and 12 more currencies.

articles.title: T-MAXIMUM
articles.summary: BEIJING, Oct. 12, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- T-MAXIMUM PHARMACEUTICAL ("T-MAXIMUM") today announced that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has cleared the company to initiate a Phase 2 clinical study of MT027, its internally developed, B7-H3-targeted universal (allogeneic) CAR-T therapy, for the treatment of patients with brain metastases from lung cancer and breast cancer. This is the second Phase 2 study of MT027 to receive FDA clearance. MT027 was previously cleared by the FDA to proceed with a Phase 2 study in recurrent glioblastoma, and has been granted Orphan Drug Designation (ODD) and Fast Track Designation (FTD). With two FDA-cleared Phase 2 programs, T-MAXIMUM has established a dual-indication portfolio for universal CAR-T therapy covering both primary and metastatic intracranial solid tumors. Image source: T-MAXIMUM official website (www.t-maximum.com) Brain Metastases: An Unanswered Clinical Question Despite Advances in Systemic Therapy Brain metastases commonly arise in patients with lung cancer, breast cancer, melanoma, renal cell carcinoma, and colorectal cancer. International studies estimate that approximately 20% of cancer patients may develop brain metastases over the course of their disease, a proportion that can reach 20% to 40% among patients with advanced solid tumors.[1][2] For patients, this means far more than an additional lesion on imaging: brain metastases may be accompanied by headaches, seizures, and cognitive and motor impairment, directly affecting daily life and subsequent treatment options. This is a truly global clinical challenge. In 2022, there were nearly 20 million new cancer cases worldwide, including nearly 2.5 million new cases of lung cancer and approximately 2.3 million new cases of female breast cancer - the two leading primary tumor types giving rise to brain metastases.[3] Asia accounts for roughly half of all new cancer cases globally;[4] in the United States, an estimated 200,000 to 300,000 patients are newly diagnosed with brain metastases each year.[2] This large patient population means brain metastasis is not a niche need, but a question that oncology worldwide must continue to answer. Systemic therapies can help control disease throughout the body, but treatment of intracranial lesions often remains constrained by multiple factors, including the blood-brain barrier, tumor heterogeneity, and the need to preserve neurological function. This is especially true for patients who experience intracranial progression after prior therapy, for whom there remains a need for more treatment options that are validated intracranially while balancing safety and accessibility. Consecutive Clinical Milestones Built on Long-Term Product and Translational Groundwork MT027's recent series of regulatory milestones is no coincidence. It reflects an integrated capability across product, manufacturing, clinical development, and regulatory affairs built around intracranial solid tumors - one that is now advancing from early exploration toward more systematic clinical validation. First, a foundation of clinical data. The company has accumulated sustained clinical experience in local delivery, repeat dosing, and safety monitoring for intracranial solid tumors. Years of clinical experience and data with MT027 have already led to two FDA-cleared Phase 2 programs. Data from an investigator-initiated trial (IIT) of MT026, a program built on the same platform, were published in Nature Communications in 2026: among 5 patients with recurrent high-grade glioma, 1 complete response and 3 partial responses were observed, for an objective response rate (ORR) of 80%, with no treatment-related Grade 3 or higher adverse events. Early clinical data for MT027 in patients with refractory brain metastases from lung cancer were previously presented at the IASLC 2026 World Conference on Lung Cancer (WCLC 2026). Five heavily pretreated patients with no guideline-recommended subsequent treatment options completed treatment; among the 3 evaluable patients, 2 partial responses were observed. The safety profile was favorable, with no Grade 3 or higher adverse events and no graft-versus-host disease (GvHD). These rigorous exploratory clinical studies provide an important basis for the clinical translation of allogeneic, locally delivered CAR-T therapy in intracranial solid tumors. Second, a well-defined manufacturing process. MT027 is manufactured using a fully non-viral gene-editing process - a generational departure from the industry's mainstream lentiviral vector approach - offering potential advantages in product safety, batch-to-batch consistency, and cost control. The manufacturing process was established and locked prior to entering Phase 2 clinical development. Third, leadership measured not only by getting there first, but by advancing systematically. For an innovative cell therapy company, leadership in regulatory progress comes from coordinated advancement across product, manufacturing, clinical development, and regulatory strategy. MT027's consecutive entry into FDA-cleared Phase 2 clinical development demonstrates T-MAXIMUM's ability to translate its prior groundwork into a repeatable and scalable clinical development capability. Management Commentary "Receiving FDA clearance for two consecutive Phase 2 studies of MT027 marks a pivotal step built on our sustained work in intracranial solid tumors. From glioma to brain metastases, we have always let the data speak and put clinical value first. Going forward, we will continue to rigorously evaluate the product's safety and potential clinical value through well-designed clinical studies, steadily advancing product supply, clinical execution, and the generation of key data, as we explore new possibilities for patients who lack effective treatment options." About MT027 MT027 is an investigational, B7-H3-targeted universal (allogeneic) CAR-T cell therapy developed by T-MAXIMUM using a fully non-viral gene-editing process and administered via local intracranial delivery. MT027 has received FDA Orphan Drug Designation and Fast Track Designation and is being evaluated in FDA-cleared Phase 2 studies in recurrent glioblastoma and in brain metastases from lung cancer and breast cancer. About T-MAXIMUM PHARMACEUTICAL T-MAXIMUM PHARMACEUTICAL is a clinical-stage cell therapy company focused on developing universal (allogeneic) CAR-T therapies for intracranial solid tumors with high unmet medical need, including recurrent glioblastoma and brain metastases. Through engineered cell therapies, local delivery strategies, and clinical translation capabilities, the Company is advancing more accessible treatment approaches with the potential to support repeat dosing. Its lead program, MT027, is a B7-H3-targeted universal CAR-T therapy that has received FDA clearance to initiate Phase 2 clinical studies in recurrent glioblastoma and brain metastases. MT027 has also received Orphan Drug Designation (ODD) in high-grade glioma and Fast Track Designation (FTD) for recurrent or progressive glioblastoma. T-MAXIMUM is working to translate its accumulated capabilities in product development, manufacturing, and clinical execution into continued innovation across both primary and metastatic intracranial solid tumors, with the goal of creating new possibilities for patients with limited treatment options. Forward-Looking Statements This press release contains forward-looking statements, including statements regarding the clinical development, potential therapeutic benefits, manufacturing advantages, and regulatory progress of MT027 and other product candidates. These statements are based on current expectations and are subject to risks and uncertainties, including those inherent in clinical development, regulatory review, and manufacturing, that could cause actual results to differ materially. Early clinical results from small numbers of patients may not be predictive of results in larger studies. MT027 is an investigational product, and its safety and efficacy have not been established.
